name: Repair Amplifier - Retaliation
RelatedDescription: An engineering backpack fitted with a high-precision robotic arm that provides professional repairs on the battlefield. Also integrates a function that enhances the ST's Retaliation capability.

61250.name: Repair Device I · Retaliation
61250.SpecificEffects:
When the action starts, repair yourself <color=#F74848>once</color>, restoring HP equal to <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT. This cannot repair damaged parts.
When Retaliating, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
